```{r init, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare"}
PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE <- get0("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", inherits = TRUE,
  ifnotfound = Sys.getenv("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", unset = "describe"))
stopifnot(PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE %in% c("describe", "differential", "enrichment"))
initialize_profile_comparison_module(
  environment(),
  RSRNA_COMPARE_FIG,
  RSRNA_COMPARE_TAB,
  "03_rsrna_compare",
  c(
    "01_sector_radar",
    "02_length_distribution",
    "03_mapping_position",
    "04_bar_rsrna",
    "05_alluvial_rsrna",
    "06_rsrna_trend",
    "32_rsrna_deep_dive"
  )
)
PANDORA_CAN_PCA <- nrow(sample_info) >= 3L
pandora_group_n <- table(as.character(sample_info$Group))
PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE <- length(pandora_group_n) >= 2L && all(pandora_group_n >= 2L)
write_csv_safe(tibble(
  AnalysisStage = PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE,
  AnalysisScope = get0("analysis_scope", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = "all"),
  LibraryN = nrow(sample_info), GroupN = length(pandora_group_n),
  PCAApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_PCA, GroupComparisonApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE
), "analysis_stage_status.csv")
```

```{r rsrna-sector-radar-compare, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
compare_rsrna_group_visual <- group_rsrna_visual_view %>%
  mutate(RsRNAClass = collapse_rsrna_radar_class(as.character(RsRNAClass))) %>%
  group_by(Group, RsRNAClass) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), Percent = sum(Percent, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
rsrna_radar_angle_offset <- -pi / length(rsrna_radar_levels)

rsrna_radar_max <- max(c(20, if (nrow(compare_rsrna_group_visual) == 0) 0 else max(compare_rsrna_group_visual$Percent, na.rm = TRUE)), na.rm = TRUE)
rsrna_radar_max <- max(ceiling(rsrna_radar_max / 5) * 5, 20)
rsrna_radar_breaks <- unique(round(seq(0, rsrna_radar_max, length.out = 5), 2))

for (group_name in group_levels) {
  group_df <- compare_rsrna_group_visual %>% filter(Group == group_name)
  if (nrow(group_df) == 0) next

  plot_df <- build_sector_radar_df(
    group_df %>% mutate(Sample = paste0("Group_", group_name)) %>% transmute(Sample, PieCategory = as.character(RsRNAClass), Reads, Percent),
    radar_max = rsrna_radar_max,
    sector_levels = rsrna_radar_levels,
    sector_labels = rsrna_radar_labels,
    sector_palette = rsrna_radar_palette,
    bottom_anchor_category = "18S-rRNA",
    angle_offset = rsrna_radar_angle_offset
  )

  group_plot <- plot_sector_radar_core(
    plot_df = plot_df,
    title_text = paste0("rsRNA Proportion of Group ", group_name),
    radar_max = rsrna_radar_max,
    radar_breaks = rsrna_radar_breaks,
    sector_levels = rsrna_radar_levels,
    sector_palette = rsrna_radar_palette,
    axis_label = "Relative Abundance within total rsRNA (%)"
  )
  save_plot_nested(group_plot, "01_sector_radar", paste0("group_", safe_dir_name(group_name), ".pdf"), width = 8.6, height = 8.2, view = REPORT_VIEW)
}

shared_radar <- plot_group_sector_radar(
  prepare_group_sector_radar(
    compare_rsrna_group_visual %>% transmute(Group, PieCategory = as.character(RsRNAClass), Percent),
    radar_max = rsrna_radar_max,
    sector_levels = rsrna_radar_levels,
    sector_labels = rsrna_radar_labels,
    bottom_anchor_category = "18S-rRNA",
    sector_palette = rsrna_radar_palette,
    angle_offset = rsrna_radar_angle_offset,
    value_digits = 1,
    min_value_label = 0.5
  ),
  title_text = paste0("rsRNA Proportion Across Groups", view_title_suffix(REPORT_VIEW)),
  radar_max = rsrna_radar_max,
  radar_breaks = rsrna_radar_breaks,
  axis_label = "Relative Abundance within total rsRNA (%)",
  sector_palette = rsrna_radar_palette,

  value_size = 1.55
)
save_plot_nested(shared_radar, "01_sector_radar", "group_compare.pdf", width = 9.2, height = 8.6, view = REPORT_VIEW)
```

```{r rsrna-mapping-position-compare, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
rsrna_mapping_levels <- setdiff(rsrna_radar_levels, "other-rRNA")
rsrna_mapping_labels <- unname(rsrna_radar_labels[rsrna_mapping_levels])
names(rsrna_mapping_labels) <- rsrna_mapping_levels

classify_rsrna_reference <- function(reference_text) {
  ref <- as.character(reference_text)
  case_when(
    str_detect(ref, "45S") ~ "45S-rRNA",
    str_detect(ref, "28S") ~ "28S-rRNA",
    str_detect(ref, "18S") ~ "18S-rRNA",
    str_detect(ref, "16S") ~ "16S-rRNA",
    str_detect(ref, "12S") ~ "12S-rRNA",
    str_detect(ref, "5\\.8S") ~ "5.8S-rRNA",
    str_detect(ref, "5S") ~ "5S-rRNA",
    TRUE ~ "other-rRNA"
  )
}

mapping_file_suffixes <- switch(
  REPORT_VIEW,
  sense = "output_rRNA_match_genome",
  antisense = "output_rRNA-antisense_match_genome",
  merged = c("output_rRNA_match_genome", "output_rRNA-antisense_match_genome"),
  "output_rRNA_match_genome"
)

load_rsrna_mapping_rows <- function(sample_tbl, file_suffixes) {
  file_suffixes <- unique(as.character(file_suffixes))
  col_names <- c("ID", "Reads", "Strand", "Reference", "Start", "Sequence", "Quality", "Mismatch", "Extra")
  empty_mapping <- tibble(Sample=character(), Group=character(), Reads=numeric(), Reference=character(), Start=numeric(), Sequence=character(), RPM=numeric())

  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(sample_tbl)), function(i) {
    sample_id <- as.character(sample_tbl$Sample[i])
    group_id <- as.character(sample_tbl$Group[i])
    clean_total <- sample_tbl$CleanReads[i] %||% 0
    sample_dir <- file.path(SPORTS_RESULT_DIR, sample_id, paste0(sample_id, "_processed"))

    map_dfr(file_suffixes, function(file_suffix) {
      file_path <- file.path(sample_dir, paste0(sample_id, "_", file_suffix))
      if (!file.exists(file_path)) return(empty_mapping)

      align_df <- read_alignment_tsv_flex(file_path, col_names)
      if (nrow(align_df) == 0) return(empty_mapping)
      rpm_values <- if (is.na(clean_total) || clean_total <= 0) rep(0, nrow(align_df)) else 1e6 * clean_numeric(align_df$Reads) / clean_total

      align_df %>%
        transmute(
          Sample = sample_id,
          Group = group_id,
          Reads = clean_numeric(Reads),
          Reference = as.character(Reference),
          Start = clean_numeric(Start),
          Sequence = as.character(Sequence),
          RPM = rpm_values
        )
    })
  })
}

expand_rsrna_mapping_coverage <- function(mapping_df) {
  if (nrow(mapping_df) == 0) {
    return(tibble(Sample = character(), Group = character(), RsRNAClass = character(), Position = integer(), RPM = numeric()))
  }

  mapping_df <- mapping_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Start), !is.na(End), End >= Start, !is.na(RPM), RPM > 0) %>%
    mutate(Start = as.integer(Start), End = as.integer(End))
  if (nrow(mapping_df) == 0) {
    return(tibble(Sample = character(), Group = character(), RsRNAClass = character(), Position = integer(), RPM = numeric()))
  }

  if (pkg_has("data.table")) {
    dt <- data.table::as.data.table(mapping_df)
    dt[, row_id := .I]
    out <- dt[, .(Position = seq.int(Start[[1]], End[[1]])), by = .(row_id, Sample, Group, RsRNAClass, RPM)]
    out[, row_id := NULL]
    return(as_tibble(out))
  }

  pmap_dfr(
    list(mapping_df$Sample, mapping_df$Group, mapping_df$RsRNAClass, mapping_df$Start, mapping_df$End, mapping_df$RPM),
    function(Sample, Group, RsRNAClass, Start, End, RPM) {
      tibble(Sample = Sample, Group = Group, RsRNAClass = RsRNAClass, Position = seq.int(Start, End), RPM = RPM)
    }
  )
}

rsrna_mapping_raw <- sample_info %>%
  transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group)) %>%
  left_join(clean_reads_tbl, by = "Sample") %>%
  load_rsrna_mapping_rows(mapping_file_suffixes) %>%
  mutate(
    RsRNAClass = classify_rsrna_reference(Reference),
    End = Start + nchar(Sequence) - 1
  ) %>%
  filter(RsRNAClass %in% rsrna_mapping_levels, !is.na(Start), !is.na(End), RPM > 0)

write_csv_safe(tibble(
  Status = if (nrow(rsrna_mapping_raw) > 0) "available" else "not_run",
  MappingRows = nrow(rsrna_mapping_raw),
  Detail = if (nrow(rsrna_mapping_raw) > 0) "Mapping profiles use available alignment rows." else "No eligible alignment rows; mapping profiles not run. Missing or empty alignment inputs do not establish biological absence."
), "rsrna_mapping_status.csv")

rsrna_mapping_coverage_sample <- expand_rsrna_mapping_coverage(rsrna_mapping_raw) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, RsRNAClass, Position) %>%
  summarise(RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

rsrna_mapping_coverage <- rsrna_mapping_coverage_sample %>%
  summarise_group_mean_rpm(c("RsRNAClass", "Position")) %>%
  select(-Reads) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels),
    RsRNAClass = factor(as.character(RsRNAClass), levels = rsrna_mapping_levels)
  )

rsrna_mapping_break_config <- list(
  "5S-rRNA" = c(3000, 8000),
  "5.8S-rRNA" = c(3000, 6000),
  "18S-rRNA" = c(10000, 50000),
  "28S-rRNA" = c(10000, 50000)
)

build_manual_broken_y_layers <- function(plot_df, y_col = "RPM", break_range = c(100000, 250000), low_break_n = 5) {
  lower_break <- break_range[[1]]
  upper_break <- break_range[[2]]
  break_gap <- max(lower_break * 0.12, 250)
  max_y <- max(plot_df[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  high_display_span <- max(lower_break * 0.85, 1)
  high_scale <- high_display_span / max(max_y - upper_break, 1)

  transform_y <- function(x) {
    ifelse(
      x <= lower_break,
      x,
      ifelse(x >= upper_break, lower_break + break_gap + (x - upper_break) * high_scale, NA_real_)
    )
  }

  high_breaks <- pretty(c(upper_break, max_y), n = 4)
  high_breaks <- high_breaks[high_breaks >= upper_break & high_breaks <= max_y]
  axis_breaks_original <- unique(round(c(seq(0, lower_break, length.out = low_break_n), high_breaks)))
  axis_breaks_display <- transform_y(axis_breaks_original)

  list(
    lower = lower_break,
    upper = upper_break,
    gap = break_gap,
    transform_y = transform_y,
    axis_breaks_original = axis_breaks_original,
    axis_breaks_display = axis_breaks_display
  )
}

infer_rsrna_length_break_range <- function(plot_df, y_col = "RPM") {
  values <- plot_df[[y_col]]
  values <- values[is.finite(values) & values > 0]
  if (length(values) < 8) return(NULL)

  max_y <- max(values, na.rm = TRUE)
  q90 <- unname(quantile(values, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE))
  q98 <- unname(quantile(values, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!is.finite(max_y) || !is.finite(q90) || !is.finite(q98)) return(NULL)
  if (max_y < 50000 || max_y < q90 * 3 || q98 <= q90 * 1.4) return(NULL)

  round_to <- if (max_y >= 100000) 10000 else 1000
  lower <- max(round(q90 / round_to) * round_to, round_to)
  upper <- round(q98 / round_to) * round_to
  if (upper <= lower) upper <- lower + round_to
  c(lower, upper)
}

build_rsrna_mapping_position_plot <- function(subtype_df, rsrna_name, legend_position = "none", use_y_break = FALSE, title_suffix = "") {
  subtype_df <- subtype_df %>% mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))
  y_label <- "RPM"
  plot_title <- paste0(rsrna_mapping_labels[[rsrna_name]], title_suffix)

  should_break_axis <- use_y_break &&
    rsrna_name %in% names(rsrna_mapping_break_config) &&
    max(subtype_df$RPM, na.rm = TRUE) > rsrna_mapping_break_config[[rsrna_name]][[2]]

  if (should_break_axis) {
    break_range <- rsrna_mapping_break_config[[rsrna_name]]
    lower_break <- break_range[[1]]
    upper_break <- break_range[[2]]
    break_gap <- max(lower_break * 0.12, 250)
    max_rpm <- max(subtype_df$RPM, na.rm = TRUE)
    high_display_span <- max(lower_break * 0.85, 1)
    high_scale <- high_display_span / max(max_rpm - upper_break, 1)

    transform_y <- function(x) {
      ifelse(x <= lower_break, x, lower_break + break_gap + (x - upper_break) * high_scale)
    }

    high_breaks <- pretty(c(upper_break, max_rpm), n = 4)
    high_breaks <- high_breaks[high_breaks >= upper_break & high_breaks <= max_rpm]
    axis_breaks_original <- c(seq(0, lower_break, by = 2500), high_breaks)
    axis_breaks_display <- transform_y(axis_breaks_original)

    plot_df <- subtype_df %>%
      filter(RPM <= lower_break | RPM >= upper_break) %>%
      mutate(
        RPMDisplay = transform_y(RPM),
        AxisSegment = if_else(RPM <= lower_break, "low", "high")
      )

    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Position, y = RPMDisplay, color = Group, group = interaction(Group, AxisSegment))) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = -Inf,
        xmax = Inf,
        ymin = lower_break,
        ymax = lower_break + break_gap,
        fill = "white",
        color = NA
      ) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(lower_break, lower_break + break_gap), linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = serum_neutral_text) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = lower_break + break_gap / 2, label = "//", hjust = 1.2, vjust = 0.5, size = 4, color = serum_text_primary) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.85, alpha = 0.95) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = axis_breaks_display,
        labels = scales::comma(axis_breaks_original),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
      ) +
      labs(y = "RPM (broken axis)")
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(subtype_df, aes(x = Position, y = RPM, color = Group, group = Group)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.85, alpha = 0.95) +
      labs(y = y_label)
  }

  p <- p +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))) +
    labs(
      x = "Position on parent rRNA (nt)",
      title = plot_title
    ) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = legend_position,
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  p
}

if (nrow(rsrna_mapping_coverage) > 0) {
  mapping_plot_list_linear <- map(rsrna_mapping_levels, function(rsrna_name) {
    subtype_df <- rsrna_mapping_coverage %>%
      filter(as.character(RsRNAClass) == rsrna_name, RPM > 0)
    if (nrow(subtype_df) == 0) return(NULL)

    build_rsrna_mapping_position_plot(subtype_df, rsrna_name, legend_position = "none", use_y_break = FALSE)
  })

  mapping_plot_list_linear <- compact(mapping_plot_list_linear)

  if (length(mapping_plot_list_linear) > 0) {
    save_plot_nested(
      build_plot_collage(
        mapping_plot_list_linear,
        title_text = "rsRNA mapping position across groups (linear y-axis)",
        cols = 3
      ),
      "03_mapping_position",
      "rsrna_mapping_position_compare_linear.pdf",
      width = 15,
      height = 10,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
  }

  mapping_plot_list_broken <- map(rsrna_mapping_levels, function(rsrna_name) {
    subtype_df <- rsrna_mapping_coverage %>%
      filter(as.character(RsRNAClass) == rsrna_name, RPM > 0)
    if (nrow(subtype_df) == 0) return(NULL)

    build_rsrna_mapping_position_plot(subtype_df, rsrna_name, legend_position = "none", use_y_break = TRUE)
  })

  mapping_plot_list_broken <- compact(mapping_plot_list_broken)

  if (length(mapping_plot_list_broken) > 0) {
    save_plot_nested(
      build_plot_collage(
        mapping_plot_list_broken,
        title_text = "rsRNA mapping position across groups (broken y-axis for 5S, 5.8S, 18S and 28S)",
        cols = 3
      ),
      "03_mapping_position",
      "rsrna_mapping_position_compare.pdf",
      width = 15,
      height = 10,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
  }

  walk(rsrna_mapping_levels, function(rsrna_name) {
    subtype_df <- rsrna_mapping_coverage %>%
      filter(as.character(RsRNAClass) == rsrna_name, RPM > 0)
    if (nrow(subtype_df) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

    subtype_plot <- build_rsrna_mapping_position_plot(
      subtype_df,
      rsrna_name,
      legend_position = "top",
      use_y_break = TRUE,
      title_suffix = " rsRNA mapping position across groups"
    ) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13))

    save_plot_nested(
      subtype_plot,
      "03_mapping_position",
      paste0("mapping_position_", safe_dir_name(rsrna_mapping_labels[[rsrna_name]]), ".pdf"),
      width = 8.8,
      height = 5.4,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
  })
}
```

```{r rsrna-length-compare, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
rsrna_length_detail <- length_all %>%
  filter(MainCategory == "rsRNA") %>%
  left_join(clean_reads_tbl, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    RPM = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 1e6 * Reads / CleanReads, 0),
    RsRNAClass = parse_rsrna_class(Class, Class)
  )

rsrna_length_sample <- rsrna_length_detail %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, RsRNAClass, Length) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

rsrna_length_levels <- setdiff(rsrna_radar_levels, "other-rRNA")

group_rsrna_length <- rsrna_length_sample %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Length) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  summarise_group_mean_rpm("Length") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

group_rsrna_subtype_length <- rsrna_length_sample %>%
  summarise_group_mean_rpm(c("RsRNAClass", "Length")) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels),
    RsRNAClass = factor(as.character(RsRNAClass), levels = rsrna_length_levels)
  )

if (nrow(group_rsrna_length) > 0) {
  group_rsrna_length_plot_df <- group_rsrna_length %>% filter(RPM > 0)

  line_plot <- ggplot(group_rsrna_length_plot_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPM, color = Group, group = Group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.95) +
    geom_point(size = 0.85) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    sncrna_length_axis() +
    labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM", title = NULL) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  bar_plot <- ggplot(group_rsrna_length_plot_df, aes(x = factor(Length), y = RPM, fill = Group)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.74), width = 0.68) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM", title = NULL) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  combined_plot <- build_plot_collage(
    list(line_plot, bar_plot),
    title_text = "rsRNA length comparison across groups",
    cols = 1
  )
  save_plot_nested(combined_plot, "02_length_distribution", "length_compare_rsrna.pdf", width = 9, height = 10, view = REPORT_VIEW)

  rsrna_total_length_break <- c(100000, 250000)
  if (max(group_rsrna_length_plot_df$RPM, na.rm = TRUE) > rsrna_total_length_break[[2]]) {
    broken_info <- build_manual_broken_y_layers(group_rsrna_length_plot_df, break_range = rsrna_total_length_break)
    group_rsrna_length_broken_df <- group_rsrna_length_plot_df %>%
      mutate(
        RPMDisplay = broken_info$transform_y(RPM),
        AxisSegment = case_when(
          RPM <= broken_info$lower ~ "low",
          RPM >= broken_info$upper ~ "high",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(RPMDisplay), !is.na(AxisSegment))

    broken_line_plot <- ggplot(group_rsrna_length_broken_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPMDisplay, color = Group, group = interaction(Group, AxisSegment))) +
      annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = broken_info$lower, ymax = broken_info$lower + broken_info$gap, fill = "white", color = NA) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(broken_info$lower, broken_info$lower + broken_info$gap), linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = serum_neutral_text) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = broken_info$lower + broken_info$gap / 2, label = "//", hjust = 1.2, vjust = 0.5, size = 4, color = serum_text_primary) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.95) +
      geom_point(size = 0.85) +
      scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      sncrna_length_axis() +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = broken_info$axis_breaks_display, labels = scales::comma(broken_info$axis_breaks_original), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
      labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM (broken axis)", title = NULL) +
      serum_theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

    broken_bar_plot <- ggplot(group_rsrna_length_broken_df, aes(x = factor(Length), y = RPMDisplay, fill = Group)) +
      annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = broken_info$lower, ymax = broken_info$lower + broken_info$gap, fill = "white", color = NA) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(broken_info$lower, broken_info$lower + broken_info$gap), linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = serum_neutral_text) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = broken_info$lower + broken_info$gap / 2, label = "//", hjust = 1.2, vjust = 0.5, size = 4, color = serum_text_primary) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.74), width = 0.68) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = broken_info$axis_breaks_display, labels = scales::comma(broken_info$axis_breaks_original), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
      labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM (broken axis)", title = NULL) +
      serum_theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

    broken_combined_plot <- build_plot_collage(
      list(broken_line_plot, broken_bar_plot),
      title_text = "rsRNA length comparison across groups (broken y-axis: 100k-250k RPM)",
      cols = 1
    )
    save_plot_nested(broken_combined_plot, "02_length_distribution", "length_compare_rsrna_broken.pdf", width = 9, height = 10, view = REPORT_VIEW)
  }
}

for (rsrna_name in rsrna_length_levels) {
  rsrna_label <- unname(rsrna_radar_labels[[rsrna_name]])
  subtype_length_df <- group_rsrna_subtype_length %>%
    filter(RsRNAClass == rsrna_name)

  if (nrow(subtype_length_df %>% filter(RPM > 0)) == 0) next

  subtype_line_plot <- ggplot(subtype_length_df %>% filter(RPM > 0), aes(x = Length, y = RPM, color = Group, group = Group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.95) +
    geom_point(size = 0.85) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    sncrna_length_axis() +
    labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM", title = NULL) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  subtype_bar_plot <- ggplot(subtype_length_df %>% filter(RPM > 0), aes(x = factor(Length), y = RPM, fill = Group)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.74), width = 0.68) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM", title = NULL) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  subtype_combined_plot <- build_plot_collage(
    list(subtype_line_plot, subtype_bar_plot),
    title_text = paste0(rsrna_label, " rsRNA length comparison across groups"),
    cols = 1
  )
  save_plot_nested(
    subtype_combined_plot,
    "02_length_distribution",
    paste0("length_compare_", safe_dir_name(rsrna_label), ".pdf"),
    width = 9,
    height = 10,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )

  subtype_length_break <- infer_rsrna_length_break_range(subtype_length_df %>% filter(RPM > 0))
  if (!is.null(subtype_length_break)) {
    broken_info <- build_manual_broken_y_layers(subtype_length_df %>% filter(RPM > 0), break_range = subtype_length_break)
    subtype_length_broken_df <- subtype_length_df %>%
      filter(RPM > 0) %>%
      mutate(
        RPMDisplay = broken_info$transform_y(RPM),
        AxisSegment = case_when(
          RPM <= broken_info$lower ~ "low",
          RPM >= broken_info$upper ~ "high",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(RPMDisplay), !is.na(AxisSegment))

    subtype_broken_line_plot <- ggplot(subtype_length_broken_df, aes(x = Length, y = RPMDisplay, color = Group, group = interaction(Group, AxisSegment))) +
      annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = broken_info$lower, ymax = broken_info$lower + broken_info$gap, fill = "white", color = NA) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(broken_info$lower, broken_info$lower + broken_info$gap), linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = serum_neutral_text) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = broken_info$lower + broken_info$gap / 2, label = "//", hjust = 1.2, vjust = 0.5, size = 4, color = serum_text_primary) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.95) +
      geom_point(size = 0.85) +
      scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      sncrna_length_axis() +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = broken_info$axis_breaks_display, labels = scales::comma(broken_info$axis_breaks_original), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
      labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM (broken axis)", title = NULL) +
      serum_theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

    subtype_broken_bar_plot <- ggplot(subtype_length_broken_df, aes(x = factor(Length), y = RPMDisplay, fill = Group)) +
      annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = broken_info$lower, ymax = broken_info$lower + broken_info$gap, fill = "white", color = NA) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(broken_info$lower, broken_info$lower + broken_info$gap), linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = serum_neutral_text) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = broken_info$lower + broken_info$gap / 2, label = "//", hjust = 1.2, vjust = 0.5, size = 4, color = serum_text_primary) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.74), width = 0.68) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = broken_info$axis_breaks_display, labels = scales::comma(broken_info$axis_breaks_original), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
      labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM (broken axis)", title = NULL) +
      serum_theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

    subtype_broken_combined_plot <- build_plot_collage(
      list(subtype_broken_line_plot, subtype_broken_bar_plot),
      title_text = paste0(rsrna_label, " rsRNA length (broken y-axis)"),
      cols = 1
    )
    save_plot_nested(
      subtype_broken_combined_plot,
      "02_length_distribution",
      paste0("length_compare_", safe_dir_name(rsrna_label), "_broken.pdf"),
      width = 9,
      height = 10,
      view = REPORT_VIEW
    )
  }
}
```
